sentences.text: This is FIRST application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail filed by the applicant- Shubham who is in custody since 03.03.2023 in connection with Crime No.49/2021 registered at Police Station Kantaphod, District Dewas for the offence punishable under Section 420 and 120-B of IPC.

As per prosecution case, Kailash Thakre and Suresh Mujalde submitted a written complaint at police station- Kantaphod that their friend Jitendra has told that he would facilitate them in getting a loan of Rs.1,50,000/- from nationalized bank.
He has directed them to bring six blank cheques for obtaining the loan.
They all went to the Hero Fin. Corporation Company and the loan of Rs.1,54,577/- and Rs.1,44,656/- were sanctioned in their name.
Jitendra Soni and the present applicant took six blank cheques from him and out of which they deposited three cheques with the finance company and retained three with them.

After sanctioning of the loan amount in favour of Kailash Thakre and Suresh Mujalde along with others has withdrawn the said amount by using the Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160037872/
1 three blank cheques.

sentences.text: Police has registered an FIR and it is revealed that the amount of Rs.1,30,000/- has been transferred from account of Suresh Mujalde and Rs.1,43,000/- transferred from the account of Kailash Thakre in the account of Palash Soni.

The trail court in its order has observed that in the account of complainant bearing No.
892010110002848, the amount of Rs. 1,43,000/- has been withdrawn by using blank cheque No.
068383 of complainant.
Rest of the amount were withdrawn by the co-accused and distributed each others.
The blank cheques were recovered from the possession of the present applicant Shubam.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent / State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case but without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed and applicant-Shubham is directed to be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court for his appearance before that Court during the pendency of trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
C.c. as per rules.
